# Stack - Gym Tracker

Spend less time logging. Bring your last workout into your next one. See your lifting progress over time.

Stack helps people keep routines ready, record sets and build a useful training history on iPhone and iPad. Stack Pro adds direction between sets with suggested targets, plate calculations and Lock Screen logging.

## Free and paid access
- Free: workout logging, routines, history, basic strength trends, muscle map, data export and import.
- Optional Stack Pro: next-set targets, plate calculations, iPhone Live Activity controls, weekly coverage targets and routine adjustments, progress photos, guided one-rep max testing, Gym Mode, exercise replacement suggestions and extra appearance choices.
- Pro has monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions and a one-time lifetime purchase. Current prices and offer eligibility appear in the app before purchase. The whole app is not subscription-only, and all features are not free.
- Stack 2.0 supports iPhone and iPad on iOS or iPadOS 26.2 or later. Lock Screen and Dynamic Island controls are for compatible iPhones.

## Data choices
No account is required for workout logging, which works offline. Optional iCloud sync uses Sign in with Apple. Optional Apple Health integration can write workouts and read or write bodyweight with permission.

Optional Firebase usage analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off in Profile > Privacy & Data. Reports include product and purchase events, installation identifiers and limited training-related values. Do not describe Stack as having no analytics, no telemetry or anonymous-only diagnostics. Read the privacy policy for details. Stack does not sell training data or use it for advertising.
